schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).

main.note: System III main rewritten for s.out: getopt, -v -l, long names, segmented formats. swap_flg is declared char here (the int of goodmagic): testb reads its high byte, always 0, so byte-swapped files are never swapped back (swaphdr, swab dead) and the default file is always a.out (s.out never). A type the switch does not name (5, 6, 0x1b..0x1d) prints the letter of the symbol before (c not set). The line table warning counts one entry too many (s_lines - i + 1). arch_flg and sep_id are never reset: after an archive argument every later file is read as an archive. The buffer symrest behind sym (name guessed) takes the entries of a long name.

compare.note: name guessed (System III name); long names compared through the name table

savename.note: name guessed; its fprintf has one argument too many (fname)

swaphdr.note: name guessed; dead code (see main: swap_flg)

putname.note: name guessed; a name longer than 44 characters is cut to 40 and "..." follows
